meta.note: per-MAC rates are MEASURED (fabric 1 clock/MAC via transformer_fabric_lock::fabric_computes_one_mac_per_clock_measured, run under iverilog; soft-core 10.625 clock/MAC from gemm_fabric.json). The whole-token cycle figures are PROJECTED = matmul_MACs * cyc_per_mac / unroll. No wall-clock claim vs any vendor part.

throughput.note: per-MAC = 1 clock is MEASURED (fabric_computes_one_mac_per_clock_measured, iverilog). tokens/sec is PROJECTED = clock / (matmul_MACs / unroll) for the matmul work (softmax/argmax orchestration extra). Unroll places u independent multiply tiles = u MACs/clock (proven ≡VM above). No wall-clock claim vs any vendor part; achievable Fmax at high unroll needs a place-and-route measurement.

datapath_int8_native.why: int8-native datapath, 1 DSP/MAC — BUILT (emit_loop_fabric_verilog_int8; synth-measured 8 DSP for the 8-wide array; routed at 66-128 MHz)

whole_net_spatial.note: The WHOLE net on the fabric, as few cycles as the board allows. 1 cycle is impossible (50,624 multipliers needed). Board-bound array width = 240 DSPs / (DSPs per MAC). The int8-native datapath is BUILT: emit_loop_fabric_verilog_int8 makes each MAC ONE DSP48E1 (synth-measured 8 DSP for the 8-wide array, vs 80 for the 64-bit datapath), so P≈240 fits the 240 DSPs → ~211 cyc/token; the routed int8-DSP bitstream (fabric_matmul_i8_r8.bit) is 8 DSP + 953 LUT at 66-128 MHz (the open nextpnr DSP-packer bug was patched). cycles/token = ceil(MACs/P). Per-MAC=1-clock is MEASURED (iverilog); the array is AUTO-EMITTED from LOGOS. No wall-clock claim vs any vendor part.
